title: Unique constructible compact-support realization
statement: Fix the finite-field datum [def-pur-conventions], a prime l distinct from its characteristic, a finite extension E of Q_l, separated finite-type schemes X,Y over its algebraically closed field, and a separated finite-type map f:X→Y with a compactification c [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Let S be any coefficient reduction/total-limit calculus on X [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], and let M be a complete bounded constructible finite-Tor integral input [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. There is a unique isomorphism rho from the actual completed proper/open image of M to scalarSupport(S,M) [def-pur-compact-support-scalar-limit-maps] such that for each exponent n+1 its reduction followed by the specified scalarSupportCounit equals the actual proper/open coefficient comparison. The definition realization selects this uniquely normalized isomorphism.

proof.text: B3: realization_existsUnique is proved from the actual normalized system morphism of [lem-pur-compact-support-projection-realization-lift]. The qcqs finite comparison makes every finite comparison an isomorphism. Scalar-limit reduction at the identity coefficient extension supplies complete target and invertible finite counits, so every reduction of the lift is an isomorphism. The recorded qcqs realization makes its source constructible; complete reduction detection makes its target constructible, and constructible reduction detection makes the lift invertible. For uniqueness, the target reduction cone is a homotopy limit. Finite shifted Hom groups over the finite-field datum kill the Milnor lim-one obstruction, hence equality of all reductions detects equality of these constructible morphisms. Cancellation of the invertible finite counits gives precisely these reduction equalities. This does not assert faithfulness on arbitrary derived objects. Identity ramification is proved locally by the identity integral coefficient inclusion and Ideal.map_id, without importing the full strict scalar-composition component.

theorem realization_existsUnique
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l E X)
    (M : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X))
    (_hM : finiteTorConstructibleIntegral l E X M) :
    ∃! ρ : (image (completed l E) c).obj M ≅
        (PurStrictScalar.scalarSupport l E c S).obj M,
      ∀ n : ℕ,
        (pbcDerivedExtend (projection l E (n + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 n) Y)).map
            ρ.hom ≫ PurStrictScalar.scalarSupportCounit l E c S n M =
          (comparison (reduction l E (n + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 n)) c).app M
